biotools.summary: Heatmapper2 is a web-based platform for generating and manipulating heatmaps, rebuilt in Python for improved performance and expanded functionality compared to its predecessor. It supports various heatmap types, including 3D, spatial, and spectrometric representations, catering to a wide range of applications in biology, ecology, and epidemiology.
